name: Shishioka Mari
source:
A character with exceptional high attack stat and specialize in melee physical damage.  The downside is that she lacks defense, which can be negated by using defensive oriented binds.

Mari is a student of Agaresta Academy, class 2-A. She have 5 brother and sisters, therefore she always helping her mother to cook for all of her family, making her become an excellent cook.

She has rather hot tempered personality, moreover due to the curse from her Binds, she become quite easily to be angry.
